name: akl-db
description: The layout-db service (design/layout-db/): a deployable Cloudflare Worker with its own D1 + R2, mirroring cmini's layouts read-only in phase 1. Owns its own dependencies -- nothing here imports from ../web, ../scripts or ../functions, and nothing outside imports this directory (tests/tools/boundary.test.ts, LDB-G5).

scripts.migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply akl-db --local --config wrangler.toml
